name: danger-hunter-1
label: Before the meeting: the plan (hunt the boar by the oak) is held in mind, focus full

name: danger-hunter-2
label: The boar appears where the plan said: a small prediction error; thought runs from the plan to standing braced

name: danger-hunter-3
label: Stand my ground wins over fighting; running away never comes into play

name: danger-hunter-4
label: As the boar closes and anger builds, fighting overtakes holding

name: danger-forager-1
label: A boar where none was expected: a full prediction error floods the mind

name: danger-forager-2
label: Danger passes the flee bar: running away, one hop from danger and made stronger by stress, wins

name: danger-forager-3
label: Still running; stress climbs and shortens thought

name: danger-allies-1
label: Surprised, with Cai and Dee beside it: the companions draw attention because Bryn is alarmed

name: danger-allies-2
label: Through Bryn's own links to 'someone who stands with me', courage lifts fighting over running away

name: danger-allies-3
label: A few ticks on, stress has shortened thought and flight takes over

name: danger-stress-1
label: Stress held at 700: rehearsal of the plan is cut, and thought is shortened

name: danger-stress-2
label: The plan's pull weakens: standing braced loses to fighting (improvising)

name: danger-call-1
label: Cai hears Bryn cry for help: Bryn, 'a cry for help' and danger come to mind

name: danger-call-2
label: Going to help wins: Cai walks towards where the cry came from

name: danger-call-3
label: The cry has brought danger to mind too; later it runs
